content:
State Bank of India is accepting (or has reopened) online applications for Junior Associates (Customer Support & Sales). Reported vacancies in public notices: 9,124 — confirm the count in the advertisement.

Read the detailed advertisement for eligibility, fee, dates and district/post-wise vacancies before you submit the form.

How to apply

  1. Open sbi.co.in/web/careers
  2. Complete registration / OTR if required
  3. Fill the form, upload documents and pay the fee
  4. Print the confirmation page
